prompt: The transcript below runs against a fresh server where counter does not exist yet. What is the value of k1 after EXEC?
explanation: The SET queues and executes fine, but INCR fails at run time with WRONGTYPE because k1 now holds the string a. Redis transactions do not roll back: the SET's result stands and k1 remains a, so the application must read the per-command results of EXEC to notice that one command failed.
code:
MULTI
SET k1 a
INCR k1
EXEC
1) OK
2) (error) WRONGTYPE Operation against a key holding the wrong kind of value

options.text: a — the SET applied and the runtime error did not roll it back
The key does not exist — the whole transaction was rolled back
1 — INCR overwrote the value despite the error
The EXEC itself returned an error and nothing executed
